freshness_states.label: Fresh
freshness_states.summary: Evidence was regenerated within the recheck window and validates against the lane's current schema.

freshness_states.label: Stale
freshness_states.summary: Evidence is older than the recheck window; the lane fails closed to retest pending until it is regenerated.

freshness_states.label: Missing
freshness_states.summary: Evidence is absent or unreadable; the lane fails closed to unsupported.

freshness_states.label: Superseded
freshness_states.summary: Evidence validates an older schema version than the lane now publishes; the lane fails closed to retest pending.

freshness_policy.summary: Lane evidence must be regenerated and re-certified within 30 days; once it falls outside the window the lane fails closed automatically.

lane_rows.summary: Query-session identity is certified on fresh evidence (search.m5.query_session_first_consumers.v1); the lane's own proof validates and every claim surface projects the same certified truth.

lane_rows.summary: Ranking explainability fails closed to limited because its source lane is degraded and a claim surface dropped parity; the lane keeps only a narrowed claim and the overclaiming surface is held back.

lane_rows.certified_claim: Saved queries, scope packs, history, and signed deep links keep raw query text local-only by default and never widen sync or export silently.
lane_rows.summary: Saved-query privacy is certified on fresh evidence (search.m5.saved_query_governance.v1); the lane's own proof validates and every claim surface projects the same certified truth.

lane_rows.certified_claim: Breadcrumb, outline, bookmark, history, and peek continuity bind to canonical anchors with visible drift and missing-target states and restore/export parity.

downgrade_rules.required_effect: When a lane's evidence is older than the recheck window, the lane fails closed to retest pending; the claim is held until the evidence is regenerated and re-certified.
downgrade_rules.rationale: Certification is only as current as its newest evidence; a stale packet cannot keep a green claim.

downgrade_rules.required_effect: When a lane's evidence validates an older schema version than the lane now publishes, the lane fails closed to retest pending until the evidence is regenerated against the current schema.
downgrade_rules.rationale: A schema bump can change the meaning of the proof; evidence on the old shape is no longer authoritative.

downgrade_rules.required_effect: When the source lane packet is itself in a degraded (narrowed) state, the lane fails closed to limited and may not imply whole-claim certainty.
downgrade_rules.rationale: The certification cannot be greener than the lane it certifies; a degraded source narrows the certified claim.

downgrade_rules.required_effect: When one claim surface (product, CLI/headless, docs/help, or support export) stops projecting the lane's certified truth, the lane fails closed to limited and the overclaiming surface is held back until parity is restored.
downgrade_rules.rationale: A surface that overclaims a greener state than the lane proves breaks the one-index promise; release and public-truth surfaces must narrow with the lane.

downgrade_rules.required_effect: When a lane's evidence is absent or unreadable, the lane fails closed to unsupported; the broad claim cannot be sustained until the evidence is restored.
downgrade_rules.rationale: An unverifiable claim is not a claim; missing evidence is the strictest fail-closed state.

downgrade_rules.required_effect: If Help/About, docs/help, support export, or the claim-publication manifest stops ingesting this certification by reference, the broad claim fails closed to unsupported until parity is restored.
downgrade_rules.rationale: The certification only governs claim truth while every consumer ingests it; a broken binding lets a surface drift.

consumer_bindings.summary: Help/About surfaces the per-lane certification state and recheck deadline verbatim so users see when search/docs/graph evidence was last certified and when it must be re-tested.
Docs/help describes the certified lanes and their freshness by reference, narrowing the prose automatically when a lane drops to retest pending, limited, or unsupported.
Support-export packets attach the same lane row ids, certification states, freshness, and downgrade tokens instead of minting a parallel badge, and stay metadata-only.
The claim-publication manifest consumes this index so a stale, limited, or unsupported lane cannot keep a broader search/docs/graph release claim green.

export_safe_summary: This metadata-safe certification index proves the four M5 search/docs/graph depth lanes — query-session identity, ranking explainability, saved-query privacy, and navigation continuity — carry current evidence: each lane cites its own evidence packet, schema, doc, artifact, fixture corpus, and record kind together with that evidence's freshness and recheck deadline, and the certification state is derived fail-closed so stale or schema-superseded evidence drops the lane to retest_pending, a degraded source lane or a broken cross-surface parity drops it to limited, and missing evidence or a missing consumer binding drops it to unsupported. Help/About, docs/help, support export, and the claim-publication manifest ingest this one index by reference and narrow with it, and no raw query text, source bodies, provider payloads, or secrets cross the boundary.
